string.text: The Monolith carried me out of %map%, %name%. It sends me back to finish.
You saw me fall at %map%. The Monolith does not let its children fall.
I bled at %map%. The Monolith drank it and gave me back.
%rank% now. The Monolith rewards those who return.
Again, %name%. Every time you spare me, I come closer to Him.
At %map% you thought it was over. Nothing is over until the Monolith says so.
I remember your face from %map%. I pray to it every night.
The light took me out of %map%. It showed me where you would be.
You cannot kill a man the Monolith has already claimed.
Each return lifts me higher, %name%. Each one brings you lower.
They call me %rank% now. Your blood will make me more.
%map% was a lesson, %name%. For you.
%count% times I came back to you, %name%. This time the Monolith sent no one else. It didn't need to.
I have stood in the light more often than any man living. Tonight I bring it to you.
Every wound you gave me, the Monolith turned into faith. I am all faith now.
No brothers this time, %name%. Only me, the light, and you.
You made me at %map%, %name%. Come and see what you made.
The Monolith has stopped counting my returns. Now it counts your breaths.
Extraction at %map% was clean, %name%. This one won't be.
Wound sealed, rank raised to %rank%. Thanks for the promotion.
Debriefed on %map%. I know how you move now.
The beacon pulled me out of %map%. Nothing will pull you out.
Same target, new orders: no witnesses this time.
You had the shot at %map%, %name%. You should have taken it.
Return number %count%. Command doesn't give up on its assets.
My file says %map%: incomplete. I'm here to close it.
They stitched me up in an hour. You've had days to run.
Teleport sickness passes. Grudges don't.
%rank% now. They gave me a bigger team. And you.
%map% taught us your habits. We adjusted.
Asset upgraded to sole operator. Team withdrawn. Target: %name%.
%count% extractions. My handlers stopped writing reports. They just send me.
No squad, no backup, and only one order. You know which one.
They retired my file number, %name%. I don't need one anymore. Neither will you.
Every time you let me go, I learned. This is the last lesson.
Command has cleared the area. It's just the two of us now.
The lab boys pulled me out of %map% in pieces. They put me back together angrier.
%rank% now, %name%. Promoted for surviving you.
The research team wants to know how you did it at %map%. So do I.
Medevac by teleport, courtesy of the institute. Your turn is coming.
Orders haven't changed since %map%: bring back %name%, any condition.
You left me breathing at %map%. A soldier doesn't forget that mistake.
Command calls me the one who came back. Let's see what they call you.
They test their machine on us, %name%. I'm their best result.
At %map% I was careless. I've had time to train.
Every jump back costs me something. Today you pay it back.
Another stripe for my sleeve. Your PDA for my wall.
I see %map% every night when I close my eyes. Tonight it ends.
They ran out of stripes for me, %name%. So they sent me alone.
%count% times through their machine. Not much of the old me is left, and all of it hates you.
No platoon this time. The institute says I'm worth one.
I stopped counting the medevacs, %name%. I started counting the days until this one.
From %map% to here. Every step was for you.
The lab's final report has one blank line. Your name goes there tonight.
Congratulations, you killed all of the Hunters. You're now free. Send a screenshot of this in the GAMMA Discord in the Nemesis Spawn System channel
Nemesis Spawn System is back. The hunt begins again.
